name: ConstructionChangeOrderManager
tagline: Potential change events to executed change orders – priced, signed off, on time and in the contract sum.
description: A complete construction change management app in one Power Apps code component: log potential change events, give notice on time, price with OH&P, subcontract markup and bond, enforce PM / Director / Executive sign-off limits, submit change order requests, record owner decisions, flow approved changes down as subcontract change orders and keep a running contract sum and revised completion date.
features: Price build-up with OH&P, subcontract markup, bond & insurance, overrides and credits
Approval limits by value enforced before submission
Notice, pricing and owner response clocks
Contract sum bridge, forecast final contract and contract sum log
Time extension tracking and revised completion
Bulk actions, undo and CSV export
Demo mode with 36 fictional change events
controlType: standard (data-set) + standard field control ConstructionChangeOrderManagerPortal for Power Pages
